title: Stripe API 2024-04: Breaking updates to Charges and PaymentIntents
plain_summary: The legacy charge.create endpoint now requires explicit customer payment_method parameters. The statement_descriptor field has been constrained to alphanumeric characters.

title: Stripe API 2024-03: Deprecation of Sources API in favor of PaymentMethods
plain_summary: The Sources API (stripe.Source) is deprecated. Developers are urged to migrate to PaymentMethods API before the sunset deadline.

title: Model Context Protocol Tool Schema Protocol Expansion
plain_summary: Model Context Protocol server tools now require tool_choice parameter and return structured JSON schemas.
